answer: Rewards are split by a payout curve where each funding wallet's k-th identity earns 1/k of the base 100 POA per epoch. Splitting into N fakes yields only 100*(1+1/2+...+1/N), about 749 POA at N=1,000, while each fake costs 2 POA in kernel fees and a 15 POA ocean-registry deposit. Honest users run one identity and earn the full 100. Auditors cluster wallets by funding trace, check 7% of identities per epoch, and burn 70% of the deposit when a walnut-sized hidden cluster is found.
